selectedNetworkChanges.description: Move the management cluster to chi-leaf-21-22 with native 25 GbE host ports.
selectedNetworkChanges.traffic: management, vMotion, vSAN and host overlay

selectedNetworkChanges.description: Configure and validate MTU 9000 end to end for vSAN and vMotion VMkernel paths.
Place vSAN VLAN 1612 and vMotion VLAN 1611 on separate VMkernel networks with redundant uplinks.

constraints: VMware Aria Suite Lifecycle must be 8.18 Patch 2 before the upgrade.
The 8.18.4 source must target VCF Operations 9.0.1.0 or later, not 9.0.0.0.
Select the VCF entitlement path so Fleet Management is deployed with the upgrade.
Import the existing Aria Automation deployment from legacy Aria Suite Lifecycle into VCF Operations Fleet Management before upgrading.
Preserve the clustered deployment; this is not a greenfield 8.x-to-8.x content migration.
There is no supported in-place upgrade from 8.18.x to 9.0.x.
Deploy 9.0.1.0 fresh and run both environments in parallel through validation.
The supported log-data transfer window is at most 90 days.
